data_fields.name: weapon_respawn_when_weaponstay_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 (only when mp_weaponstay > 0 and the weapon is not LIMITINWORLD)

best_idea: A second copy of an owned weapon is never attached as a second item: its ammo is clamped into the owned weapon's reserve and the copy is removed, while the spawn point still gets its own respawn timer.
decision_why: The pickup gate, the duplicate-to-ammo conversion and the reserve clamp form one small server rule for loot that Frankendom can test; the donor's respawn-by-copying-the-entity is not kept, and respawn becomes a timer per spawn point (row 23 for the timers).
acceptance: Walking over a second MP5 while the reserve has room adds its ammo to the first MP5 and removes the second pickup; at a full reserve the second pickup is refused and stays on the ground; a taken pickup returns after its timer (20 s weapon, 30 s item, 20 s ammo).
